title: Pirates and Ninjas and Aliens, Oh My!
author: John Cater
description: In this game, you play as a child who wakes at night, sensing something wrong. Your stuffed Kermit the Frog warns you that they'll be here soon, and then your window blows in, revealing something floating outside and close enough to jump across to. Kermit says, "They're here! It's time! You must go!"
